sections.content: Combine ¿*Has*... *alguna* *vez*? with short answers using *sí* + *pretérito* *perfecto* or *no* + *nunca* + *pretérito* *perfecto*. Keep the auxiliary and participle together in the answer.

items.english: Have you ever seen a boat?

items.spanish: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un puerto?
items.english: Have you ever been to a port?

items.spanish: No, nunca he estado en un puerto.
items.english: No, I have never been to a port.

sections.content: Short answers usually leave out *alguna vez*: *sí, he visto muchas* needs no *alguna vez* tacked on, and *no, nunca he estado*… already says it with *nunca*.
